set.n: Old recluse's fortune, house burned at Garden
set.pl: Garden village, Delta Co; house not located
pinev: Village-level: the 1909 reports place the house at Garden, Delta Co; house not located (about 1.5 km).
set.st: The night of 3 Feb 1909 an aged recluse who lived alone at Garden died when his house burned from a defective chimney; his fortune was said to be hidden in the house, and some believed he was murdered for his money. No report of coins found in the ruins. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: House burned; coins could survive in the cellar hole. Place the house on a c.1909 Delta Co plat. Access: unknown.
src: Clipping (TN TreasureNet Treasure Legends - Michigan thread 243614)
